issues_in: Source URL https://www.tricitiesbusinessnews.com/articles/amazon-plans-another-data-center-southwest-of-tricities returns HTTP 404 (confirmed via curl GET and web browse; hard-fail
fixed: Confirmed the flagged URL is genuinely dead: curl HEAD and GET both returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-11 retry.

Found and verified a working replacement: https://www.tricitiesbusinessnews.com/articles/amazon-plans-another-data-center-southwest-of-tri-cities (HTTP 200 via curl; web browse confirmed title 'Amazon plans another data center southwest of Tri-Cities' by Ty Beaver on the same publisher). The dead slug 'tricities' is a site-side rename of the live canonical slug 'tri-cities' for the same article.
Replaced the dead URL in data.json sources.refresh_2026_08_11 with the live canonical URL.

Updated NOTES.md 2026-08-11 section: swapped the dead URL in the related-context source list (LUD-N-089-25 / PDX 154, Tax Lot 136) and added a dated 'source swap (fix pass 2026-08-11)' bullet documenting the 404 and the replacement.
Validated data.json parses as valid JSON after the edit.
remaining_risks: Replacement is the same article by title/author/snippet and returns HTTP 200, but the full article text artifact was not readable from the sandbox; content-level equivalence beyond title/author/snippet is inferred.
The old dead slug remains only inside NOTES.md prose documenting the swap (intentional per fix brief), not as a live source link.
Secondary syndicated copy at 610kona.com verified live but not added, to keep the evidence set to the original publisher's canonical URL.
summary: Fixed the single review issue for USDC-0138: the Tri-Cities Business News source URL returning HTTP 404 was replaced with the same article's live canonical slug (southwest-of-tri-cities, HTTP 200 verified) in data.json sources, with a dated NOTES.md 2026-08-11 'source swap' bullet documenting the change. data.json validates as JSON; no other issues were listed for this center.
